modules.name: Web Panel
modules.description: Web platform with 20 features used by Raghuvir Admin and Assigned Person.

modules.name: Mobile App
modules.description: Single mobile app with 39 features that shows a different home screen and menu for each role: Common, Resident, Society Manager and Watchman.

modules.name: Common Backend
modules.description: One backend shared by all platforms that serves the Web Panel and the Mobile App.

requirements.title: Role-based home screen and menu in Mobile App
requirements.description: The one Mobile App must show a different home screen and menu for each role.

requirements.title: Common features for all app users
requirements.description: The Mobile App must provide 7 common features that are used by all app users.

requirements.title: Resident features in Mobile App
requirements.description: The Mobile App must provide 12 features for residents, who are owners or tenants living in the flat.

requirements.title: Society Manager features in Mobile App
requirements.description: The Mobile App must provide 14 features for Society Managers, who are committee members with permissions.

requirements.title: Watchman features in Mobile App
requirements.description: The Mobile App must provide 6 features for Watchmen, who are gate security.

requirements.title: Web Panel features for Admin and Assigned Person
requirements.description: The Web Panel must provide 20 features used by Raghuvir Admin and Assigned Person.

requirements.title: Single common backend for all platforms
requirements.description: All platforms must use one common backend.

rules.title: Users see only their own project's data
rules.description: Every user sees only the data of their own project. This check runs on the server for every request.
